exec_summary.headline: A compact model makes building-control forecasting easier to reproduce
exec_summary.body: TTM4HVAC cuts HVAC power forecast error by up to 36% and indoor-temperature error by up to 44% after fine-tuning on simulated buildings. The checkpoints and install steps are public.

exec_summary.headline: Research agents turn a months-long brain-cell analysis into 32 minutes
exec_summary.body: Thousands of parallel agents analyzed millions of mouse-brain cells and surfaced a DCTN1 cholesterol lead, giving research teams a concrete pattern for splitting complex scientific work.

exec_summary.headline: Personal agents are starting to work between prompts
exec_summary.body: Claude Duet brings proactive briefings and background work into a consumer app, while creators and builders test what an always-on assistant can take off their hands.

exec_summary.headline: A free coding model brings agentic development onto a laptop
exec_summary.body: Recursive's Flint runs a roughly 40-billion-parameter coding model at more than 125 tokens per second on a MacBook Pro, while the company says an automated research system helped build it.

exec_summary.headline: Independent builders keep turning AI workflows into usable tools
exec_summary.body: This week's projects span a local video editor with an MCP port, agent memory that hands tasks across coding tools, and open science builds for energy simulation and computational chemistry.
